function: A DNN maps the BS-RIS and RIS-user channels to the STAR-RIS deployment (rotation) angle; power and transmission/reflection coefficients come from classical optimization. p. 1, 3
system: Single-antenna BS and K single-antenna users, direct links blocked; STAR-RIS (simultaneously transmitting and reflecting), UPA, N=16; bandwidth 5 MHz, carrier not stated. p. 1, 2, 4
method: Supervised DNN regression (multi-layer, ReLU, one output) on deployment angles labeled by exhaustive search; MSE loss, Adam, 100 epochs, 10000 samples, 70% training. p. 3, 4
data_channel: Own simulator: Rician BS-RIS and RIS-user channels (K-factor 5 dB), distance path loss; 10000 samples labeled by exhaustive search; no standard or measured channel. p. 2, 4
test_conditions: Train on 70% of 10000 samples, test on the remaining 30% of the same data; N=16 by default, 16-64 in Figs. 3 and 5. p. 4
baselines: Non-learned only: random fixed angle and exhaustive angle search; no learned baseline compared. p. 4
metrics: Spectral efficiency (bit/s/Hz) versus transmit power and number of STAR elements; validation MSE of the DNN. p. 4, 5
complexity: Order O(KN^2) for the deployment angle step; overall O(KN^2 + Iout Iin K N^3.5), exhaustive O(I Iout Iin K N^3.5); no runtime or parameters. p. 4
openness: none. The dataset is generated by the authors; no code or data link. p. 4
q1_support: p. 2: "are respectively modeled as Rician distribution [10]". Own Rician model with distance path loss; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 4: "with 70% allocated for training the DNN model and the remaining for testing purposes". Test data are a held-out part of the same dataset; Fig. 5 varies N, but the DNN input size depends on N (p. 3), and no trained model is tested under other conditions.
q3_support: p. 4: "we conducted comparisons with two baseline approaches" ("Random angle" and "Exhaustive angle"). Both are non-learned; no earlier learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 4: "Hence, the overall computational complexity of Algorithm 2 is" O(KN^2 + Iout Iin K N^3.5), with O(KN^2) for the DNN deployment angle and O(I Iout Iin K N^3.5) for exhaustive search.
q5_support: p. 4: "A dataset comprising 10000 samples is generated". The data are generated by the authors; no code or data link, public dataset or measured data appears in the paper.
notes: Include, area 3 (STAR-RIS configuration). Only the deployment (rotation) angle is learned (p. 3); power allocation and transmission/reflection coefficients are solved by classical optimization (interior point and penalty method, p. 3-4). The reviewer should confirm that the RIS deployment angle counts as RIS configuration within area 3 and not as RIS hardware design or placement. The number of users K is not given in the simulation text (p. 4). The article is a letter.
